user.title: Connect to your Voltie Charger
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your charger on the local network. Username and password are only required if you have enabled HTTP authentication in the mobile app.

data_description.port: HTTP API port of the charger. Leave at 5059 unless you changed it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Voltie Charger
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this charger.

data_description.port: HTTP API port of the charger. Leave at 5059 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Voltie Charger discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the charger at {host} to Home Assistant?

discovery_auth.title: Authenticate with the discovered charger
discovery_auth.description: The charger at {host} requires a username and password.

api_disabled.title: HTTP API is disabled on this charger
api_disabled.description: The charger at **{host}** is visible on your network, but its HTTP API is turned off. Enable it in the Voltie mobile app under **Settings → Advanced Settings → Experimental → HTTP API config**, then press Retry.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the charger
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the updated credentials for the charger at {host}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the charger. Check the host and that the charger is on the network.
error.invalid_auth: The charger rejected the username or password.
error.incomplete_credentials: Provide both a username and a password, or leave both blank for no authentication.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the logs for details.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the charger at the given address.
abort.wrong_charger: The charger at this address has a different ID than the one configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the charger. Lower values update faster but increase load on the charger.

display_text.name: Display text
display_text.description: Scrolls a text message across the charger's display.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to scroll across the display (1-100 characters).

repeat_count.name: Repeat count
repeat_count.description: How many times the message scrolls across the display. Defaults to once.

clear_first.name: Clear first
clear_first.description: Show this message immediately, cancelling any active and queued messages.

set_rear_led.name: Set rear LED
set_rear_led.description: Sets the rear LED colour and brightness for a period, after which it reverts to its default colour.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: LED intensity from 0.0 to 1.0. Zero turns the LED off.

color_rgb.name: Colour
color_rgb.description: RGB colour as a hex value, for example #FF8800. Sets the channel ratios; overall intensity comes from the brightness.

duration_sec.name: Duration
duration_sec.description: Seconds before the LED reverts to its default colour. Defaults to 3600, which is also the maximum; zero is treated by the charger as the maximum, so use a brightness of 0 to turn the LED off instead.

start_charging.name: Start charging
start_charging.description: Starts a charging session, optionally recording an RFID tag and name in the charging record.

id_tag.name: RFID tag ID
id_tag.description: RFID tag ID to record against the session (8-20 characters).

name.name: Name
name.description: Name to record against the session (up to 30 characters).

add_rfid_tag.name: Add RFID tag
add_rfid_tag.description: Adds a new RFID tag to the charger's stored tag list. Requires API v5 firmware.

id.name: Tag ID
id.description: RFID tag ID as a hexadecimal value, 8 to 20 characters (0-9, A-F).

name.name: Name
name.description: Friendly name for the tag (up to 30 characters).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the tag may be used to start charging. Defaults to enabled.

modify_rfid_tag.name: Modify RFID tag
modify_rfid_tag.description: Changes an existing RFID tag. The tag ID identifies the tag and cannot be changed. Requires API v5 firmware.

id.name: Tag ID
id.description: Hexadecimal ID of the existing tag to modify.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the tag may be used to start charging.

delete_rfid_tag.name: Delete RFID tag
delete_rfid_tag.description: Removes an RFID tag from the charger's stored tag list. Requires API v5 firmware.

id.name: Tag ID
id.description: Hexadecimal ID of the tag to delete.

start_rfid_learn.name: Start RFID learn mode
start_rfid_learn.description: Puts the charger into RFID learn mode so presented tags are added to its stored list. Requires API v5 firmware.

timeout_sec.name: Timeout
timeout_sec.description: Seconds to stay in learn mode. Defaults to 30.

count_max.name: Maximum tags
count_max.description: Stop after learning this many tags. Zero learns without a limit.

list_rfid_tags.name: List RFID tags
list_rfid_tags.description: Returns the RFID tags stored on the charger. Requires API v5 firmware.

first_item.name: First item
first_item.description: Index of the first tag to return, for paging through a long list.

max_count.name: Maximum count
max_count.description: Maximum number of tags to return. Zero returns all of them.
